hero.subhead: Quad is the buy-and-sell board for your campus only. Real students, verified with a .edu, meeting between classes — no shipping, no strangers, no fees.
hero.trustNote: Every seller here is a verified student.

feed.title: On the board right now
feed.subtitle: Sorted by newest. Prices are what students actually paid last semester, not retail.
feed.noMatchesBody: Nothing matched your filters. Try widening your search.
feed.nothingYetBody: Be the first — post an item in this category and it goes to the top of the board.

auth.loginSub: Log in to pick up where you left off — messages, saved items, and your listings.
auth.privacyNote: Quad only verifies that your email belongs to your school. We never post to your account or share your address with buyers.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.verifyToUse: Verify your student ID to use the cart
cart.verifyToUseBody: Quad only opens buying and selling up to verified students, to keep the marketplace to real people on campus.
cart.emptyBody: Browse the board and add something you want — it'll show up here.
cart.pickupNote: Pickup is arranged directly with each seller — no shipping.
cart.checkoutNote: You'll pick a delivery spot and time next — sellers still need to accept your request.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.subtitle: This sends a request to each seller — they'll accept or decline before anything's final. No payment happens here.
checkout.addLocation: Add where you want to receive your order.
checkout.cartEmptyBody: Add something first, then come back to checkout.

orders.sentBody: Requests you send at checkout will show up here.

verify.title: Verify your student ID
verify.subtitle: Quad only allows verified students to post listings and message each other. Upload your student ID and Aadhar card — an admin reviews submissions by hand, usually within a day or two.
verify.aadharHint: Used only to confirm identity — kept private, never shown publicly.
verify.alreadyVerifiedBody: Nothing else to do here — head back to your profile.

verify.rejectedBody: {{reason}} Fix the issue and resubmit below.
verify.uploadIdCard: Upload a photo of your student ID card.
verify.uploadAadhar: Upload a photo of your Aadhar card.

messages.title: Messages
messages.verifyToMessage: Verify your student ID to message people
messages.verifyToMessageBody: Quad only opens messaging up to verified students, to keep conversations to real people on campus.
messages.noConversationsBody: Message a seller from a listing to start one.
messages.pickConversation: Pick a conversation to read it.

admin.title: Verification review
admin.subtitle: Review student ID and Aadhar submissions. Decisions made here or via the one-click email link are both logged for audit purposes.
admin.nothingPending: No submissions are waiting on review right now.
admin.nothingApproved: No submissions have been approved yet.
admin.nothingRejected: No submissions have been rejected yet.

notifications.orderCompleted: An order is complete — you can review the seller now
notifications.newListingMatch: New listing matching your saved search

footer.tagline: The student-only marketplace. Verified with your .edu, priced for a meal plan, picked up between classes.
footer.rights: © 2026 Quad Marketplace. Built by students, for students.

sellFlow.title: Move-out sells itself in three steps
sellFlow.subtitle: The average listing goes up in 40 seconds. List it, meet up, done.
sellFlow.step1Body: One photo from your desk is enough. Add a title and a fair campus price.
sellFlow.step2Body: Choose your dorm lobby, the library steps, or the union. Buyers only see spots you approve.
sellFlow.step3Body: Chat, agree on a time, and meet up. No shipping labels, no platform cut, no fees.
sellFlow.feesNote: Zero seller fees — keep the whole price.

campusTrust.title: Safe because it stops at the campus gates
campusTrust.eduOnlyBody: Accounts are tied to a verified school email, so the person on the other end sits in your lecture halls.
campusTrust.publicPickupBody: Meetups happen at dorm desks, libraries, and the union — never an off-campus address.
campusTrust.zeroFeesBody: Keep the whole price. Quad is funded by campus partners, not a cut of your textbook money.
